in_sanskrit.name: Rajarth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है King, Ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rajarth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Raj means 'king' in Sanskrit and Sanskritic languages. Arth means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. Rajarth thus translates to 'King of Wealth'.

in_hindi.name: राजारथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: वसिले वाला राजा (King who rules over wealth)

in_tamil.name: Rajarth
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் King, Ruler
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rajarth ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Raj means 'king' in Sanskrit and Sanskritic languages. Arth means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. Rajarth thus translates to 'King of Wealth'.

in_telugu.name: Rajarth
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rajarth ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Raj means 'king' in Sanskrit and Sanskritic languages. Arth means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. Rajarth thus translates to 'King of Wealth'.

in_marathi.name: Rajarth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajarth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj means 'king' in Sanskrit and Sanskritic languages. Arth means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. Rajarth thus translates to 'King of Wealth'.

in_bengali.name: Rajarth
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ King, Ruler
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rajarth একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Raj means 'king' in Sanskrit and Sanskritic languages. Arth means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. Rajarth thus translates to 'King of Wealth'.
